units.text: Aspose.Email FOSS for .Net reads and writes MSG and EML files, and inspects CFB containers. It converts EML messages to MSG and back, and it reads CFB containers to inspect their structure. The library implements MSG and EML handling natively without external dependencies.
It reads MSG files from streams or files using MsgReader.FromFile or MsgReader.FromStream and writes them back with Save, preserving MAPI structure and metadata.
It creates new messages with MapiMessage.Create, sets sender and recipient details, attaches files via streams, and saves the result as an MSG file.
It converts EML files to MSG using MapiMessage.LoadFromEml and writes them back to EML format with SaveToEml, using a built-in MIME implementation.
It opens CFB containers from files or streams with CfbReader.FromFile, exposes sector size and directory entry count, and iterates the internal tree structure.
It reads and writes arbitrary MAPI properties on messages using SetProperty and GetPropertyValue, beyond the strongly-typed members exposed directly.
It adds recipients with AddRecipient and attaches files or embedded messages with AddAttachment and AddEmbeddedMessageAttachment.
The first example reads a MSG file and prints its subject line using Aspose.Email FOSS for .Net.
The second example creates a new MSG file with a sender, recipient, attachment, and body, then saves it to disk using Aspose.Email FOSS for .Net.
The following examples demonstrate converting EML to MSG and inspecting a CFB container's structure.
Convert an EML file to MSG and back to EML using Aspose.Email FOSS for .Net.
Inspect the CFB structure of an MSG file using CfbReader.

Aspose.Email FOSS for .Net provides low-level readers and writers for Outlook MSG and Outlook Storage formats, with Aspose.Email.Foss.Msg.MsgReader as the entry point for reading MSG files. It supports strict parsing mode and exposes validation issues encountered during reading.

Aspose.Email.Foss.Msg.MsgReader reads MSG files from a file path or stream, supports strict parsing mode, and exposes validation issues through its ValidationIssues property; it implements IDisposable and must be disposed after use.
The getting started guide covers installation, walkthroughs, and feature guides for this library.
The how-to guides and FAQ provide task-focused answers for common MSG, CFB, and EML questions.
The full API reference offers the complete, browsable reference for all 29 public types.
The public API summary lists the repository's own stable-namespace and primary-type list.
The changelog documents the release history.
Users can open issues on GitHub for bug reports or feature requests.
Aspose.Email FOSS for .Net reads and writes email files in local storage using the Aspose.Email.Foss package version 26.7.0 for net8.0.
It does not support IMAP, SMTP, or POP3 protocols and works only with local files, not mail servers.
It does not parse or generate Transport Neutral Encapsulation Format files.
It does not provide a dedicated calendar or appointment API, though calendar-specific MAPI properties can be accessed generically via SetProperty and GetPropertyValue.
It requires the .NET 8.0 SDK to build and the matching .NET 8.0 runtime to run, and does not support classic .NET Framework 4.x.

Aspose.Email FOSS for .Net targets net8.0 and uses the dotnet CLI for building and testing. The test project, located under tests/Aspose.Email.Foss.Tests, uses the xUnit test framework with Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk 17.8.0, xunit 2.5.3, and xunit.runner.visualstudio 2.5.3, along with coverlet.collector 6.0.0 for code coverage; these dependencies apply only to the test project and are not included in the published package. The test suite validates CFB round-trips, MSG reading, and EML round-trip conversion through classes such as CfbRoundTripTests, MsgReaderTests, MapiMessageTests, MapiMessageEmlTests, and MetadataSmokeTests. Example programs for creating MSG and EML files, reading MSG content, and summarizing MSG metadata reside in the examples/ directory, each in its own project file.

it adds broader format and protocol coverage: direct IMAP/SMTP/POP3 mail-server connectivity, TNEF (winmail.dat) support, calendar and appointment APIs, and classic .NET Framework support alongside this edition's MSG, CFB, and EML processing.
CfbConstants provides constant values used in Compound File Binary format processing.
CfbDocument represents a Compound File Binary structure and provides methods to load it from files, streams, or readers.
CfbException represents errors that occur during Compound File Binary format processing.
CfbNode represents a node in a Compound File Binary structure with properties such as name, class identifier, timestamps, and state bits.
CfbReader provides functionality to read and navigate a Compound File Binary structure, including accessing directory entries, streams, and storage nodes.
CfbStorage represents a storage node in a Compound File Binary structure that can contain child storages and streams.
CfbStream represents a stream node in a Compound File Binary structure that holds binary data.
CfbWriter provides functionality to write a Compound File Binary structure.
DirectoryEntry represents an entry in the directory of a Compound File Binary structure.
DirectoryEntryNameComparer provides a comparer for directory entries based on their names.
Header represents the header information of a Compound File Binary structure.
MapiAttachment represents an attachment in a MAPI message.
MapiMessage represents a MAPI message and provides access to its properties, recipients, and attachments.
MapiProperty represents a single property in a MAPI message.
MapiPropertyCollection represents a collection of MAPI properties.
MapiRecipient represents a recipient in a MAPI message.
MsgConstants provides constant values used in MSG format processing.
MsgDocument represents an MSG format file and provides methods to load it from files, streams, or readers.
MsgException represents errors that occur during MSG format processing.
MsgReader provides functionality to read and navigate an MSG format file.
MsgStorage represents a storage node in an MSG format file.
MsgStorageRole specifies the role of a storage node in an MSG format file.
MsgStream represents a stream node in an MSG format file.
MsgWriter provides functionality to write an MSG format file.
